mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 750K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 750K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 7.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal indicates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals improved supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% indicates slowing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumption.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is below its 3-month moving average, the combined signal indicates a monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9% always signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of other economic conditions.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE > 9%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average, combined with a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6%, signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical consumer demand indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
